tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the tool catalog by keyword. Returns matching tool names, descriptions, parameters and a tested example argument object for each.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run a catalog tool by name with an arguments object. Returns the tool result and the external hosts contacted (usually none). Errors keep the HTTP status: 400 invalid input, 405 wrong method, 413 input over the size limit (files over 10 MB through MCP, JSON over 2 MiB), 422 a file that cannot be pro

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List tool categories with counts and example tool names.
